blocks.text: Exercise 1. a) done: The president inaugurated yesterday the new hospital in the eastern suburbs. · b) Statement: The Minister of Health said that the hospital will welcome 500 patients a day. · c) Interpretation: The project reflects the growing interest of the State in marginalised areas. · d) opinion: It is a result that deserves appreciation after years of abandonment. · e) The cost of the project was: 80 millions of dollars, according to the Ministry's statement. · f) Opinion (proposal): It is time to extend this experience to the other provinces.
d) ⁧وزعم⁩ : Statement (with the distance of the journalist).
f) ⁧ويرجع محللون ذلك إلى⁩ : Ascribed interpretation.

Exercise 4. a) established cause (by the journalist, without data): Road accidents have increased due to bad road conditions. · b) attributed cause: Experts attribute the increase in accidents to the use of the telephone to driving. · c) only suggested (coincidence): The increase in accidents coincided with the removal of speed cameras on the highway. · d) data (descriptive, not causal): A study of ten thousand accidents showed that the 60% It happened at night. · e) confirmed cause: The rain contributed to the increase of accidents on Sunday. Exercise 8. a) • Interpreting attributed: some experts attribute the crisis to drought. · b) Declaration: the Minister said that the work was finished (to be checked). c) The paper's opinion, presented as it stands: the government would have failed. d) Lacuna: the figure has no source. e) The decision coincided with the visit of the ambassador (no declared causal relationship).

a) Facts with source: inauguration yesterday by the head of government; capacity 100 000 m3 per day (communicated the Ministry); cost approx. 300 million, one third financed by a loan from a regional development bank; four years of work; network dating back to the seventies (attributed to experts, but presented as data). Declarations: the Head of Government ( ⁧قال⁩ , ⁧مؤكدا⁩ ): the power station will end its inconveniences; Two other short power plants (i.e., two smaller power stations); opposition ( ⁧وصف⁩ ): "Electoral propaganda" (i.e. the government ( ⁧أكدت⁩ ): date fixed for more than one year; population ( ⁧يقول⁩ ): no change. Interpreting: experts ( ⁧يعزو⁩ ) attribute the crisis to the fall in rain and the net losses; one third of the water lost ( ⁧يقدر بعضهم⁩ ). Opinions: I move in the right direction ( ⁧لا شك⁩ ), only one power station will not suffice ( ⁧من الواضح⁩ ), the request for a distribution calendar ( ⁧آن الأوان⁩ , ⁧في تقديرنا⁩ ). Views disguised: ⁧ولا شك أن⁩ …» e « ⁧من الواضح أن⁩ …». Coincidence: inauguration close to the municipal elections; The opposition infers that this is propaganda. Lack of data on the third: who estimates it (-some) by which method, on what period; the ministry did not comment. The newspaper speaks firsthand: ⁧لا شك أن⁩ , ⁧من الواضح أن⁩ , ⁧في تقديرنا⁩ (and rhetorical question ⁧ويبقى السؤال⁩ ).

b) Data: 6000 young people 18–30 years in eight countries; 70% use social media as the first source, 20% television; only one fourth check the source before sharing. Authors' interpretations: • indicates a crisis of confidence ( ⁧تدل⁩ , strong affirmation); The lack of media independence is likely ( ⁧يرجحون⁩ ); warning about increased exposure to false news ( ⁧يحذرون⁩ ). Recommendations: Media education at school, support for independent journalism. Limits: countries are not appointed; the selection method is not explained; The online survey excludes those who do not use the Internet. The title generalises ('young Arabs') more than the sample allows.

Exercise 10. 1. Exports of citrus fruits have fallen by 12% in the last season: farmers attribute it to increased transport costs, while according to the Ministry the cause is drought. 2. According to the author it is clear that the government has not learned from the previous crisis. 3. The company's announcement of a dismissal plan coincided with the publication of its record financial results, which provoked the anger of the unions. 4. The report shall not indicate the source from which it has obtained its data, nor the period to which it relates. 5. The time has come, as several experts say, to review the tax system as a whole. Delicate points: in 1 two cases attributed to two different sources; in 2 ⁧في رأي الكاتب⁩ it is to be stored; in 3 ⁧تزامن⁩ (The anger of the unions is a reported fact, causality is not); in 4 the double gap; in 5 the opinion given to experts. Exercise 11. Personal answer. The tutor controls: the six sections; no judgement in the summary; any fact with the missing source or alert; Arab verbs of declarations; the formulas ⁧لا شك أن⁩ , ⁧من الواضح أن⁩ , ⁧في تقديرنا⁩ indicated as views of the newspaper; the coincidence with the elections reported as such, with the reading of the attributed opposition; gaps (estoration of the third of water, absence of comment from the ministry, no data on distribution between neighborhoods) without hypothesis on intentions. Exercise 12. a) Because it contains an unproved judgment and explanation, presented as obvious. A probable event (unemployment has risen), an interpretation (the cause) and a judgment ('failures') The newspaper gives the government responsibility for... He's looking for him in an official source. b) The news is sacred, the commentary is free: the news in the news pages, without adjectives or judgments; the opinions on the comments page, signed. Because it mixes a fact (the increase) with an unproved cause and judgment. The increase in the world price of wheat. That two facts happened together are not for this cause and effect. c) Done (with the organizers' source): opening of the fair, 500 publishers from 30 countries. Declaration: Minister expects the most successful fair in her history. Ascribed interpretation: some publishers attribute the expected turnout to the fall in ticket prices. Ascribed opinion: others say the paper book still suffers. Opinion disguised: ⁧ومن الواضح⁩ … ⁧أن المعرض أصبح موعدا لا غنى عنه⁩ ».

14. opinion disguised as fact · 15–16. The increase in 30% thefts; lack of source, period and comparison (compared to when?). · 17–18. « ⁧من الواضح أن السبب هو إغلاق مركز الشرطة⁩ "A case presented as obvious, without evidence. · 19–20. He suggests, without saying it, that new families should be responsible for theft: it is an insinuation without any proof, which can stigmatize a group of people; in a note it should be indicated as an unfounded approach, never taken as information.
